Subject: MosaicSync <> Redwood: integration scope & account overlap question

Diego —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quick note from our GTM/product teams: as we start mapping joint-target accounts we detected some overlap in coverage between our field teams and two of Redwood's AE territories (NW and Central). Before we put resources against co-selling motions, we wanted to confirm how Redwood prefers to handle partner-driven pipeline where internal territories conflict.

Attached a first-pass "pipeline mosaic map" with accounts colored by confidence and partner interest. We also sketched proposed playbooks (co-sell lead handling, attribution, and referral fees). Hoping to sync on a lightweight mechanism so we can move to mutual action plans without stepping on reps.

Questions for you:
- Can you confirm the current owner for the listed accounts (sheet tab: disputed_accounts)?
- Would Redwood be open to a short claims/escrow hold for accounts that both parties qualify, to be released after an initial discovery call?
- Who should be the internal rapid-escrow approver for disputed assignments?

Appreciate any direction — cc'ing Ellen from Acme Cloud who is in the early evaluation and raised this as a blocker.

Best,
Brian
Partnerships Lead, MosaicSync
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Re: MosaicSync <> Redwood: integration scope & account overlap question

Brian — thanks for the clear deck and the map. Short answers up front, then proposed flow:

1) Account owners: we have a mix. NW accounts are owned by the NW AE pod; Central accounts are split between Emma Patel (NW pod) and Jonas Weber (Central). I'll attach a marked sheet with our canonical owner and OpenPipe CRM tags.

2) Claims/escrow: yes, we can do a lightweight claims hold. Proposed "Partner Claim Escrow" flow:
   - When both sides qualify an account, partner submits a Claim Form (HubSpot custom form) and marks the account as "Escrow-Claimed".
   - Redwood has a 72-hour window to accept/contest. No active outbound by the contested AE during hold except a discovery intro supported by both parties.
   - If contested, AE + partner coordinate a joint discovery; ownership resolved by activity (meeting + qualified BANT) or by Alliances arbitration.

3) Rapid approver: I recommend Marissa Cole (Head of Alliances) as the 1st-line approver for disputes; Jonas or Camila can adjudicate region-specific edge cases.

Action items I propose this week:
- I will upload a Redwood-annotated mosaic map (see attachment).
- Marissa, can you confirm you are OK being the approver and the arbitration SLAs?
- Brian/Ellen, are you comfortable with the 72-hour window and the limited outreach rule?

Thanks — want to keep this lightweight so we can start joint pipeline motions next week.
